description: After failed high-frequency optimism and overaggressive opponent prediction, test coupled slow-weight Lookahead. Both players perform original Adam updates; every fifth G response interpolate ALL initialized D/G/prior weights halfway from saved slow weights to current fast weights and make those the new slow/fast weights. Original moments persist. Synchronization occurs jointly after G (before host EMA/evaluation). Standard fixed k=5/alpha=0.5 mechanism, not a coefficient sweep. One accepted D/G Adam call per original host update; extra joint interpolation operations, no extra gradients or forwards. Slow tensors stored in optimizer state; cadence stored in correction state for continuation.
initialization: retained audited CPU fixtures; native CUDA training and random draws

compute.base_updates: one D and one G per host outer step; no added critic steps
compute.comparison: equal outer steps and equal model/gradient evaluations; added tensor arithmetic/memory, wall time measured

checkpoint: memory stored in optimizer state; qualification continuation required after all 22
